messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 — Model init failures in us-east-1. Auto-pager fired for nodes in cluster-rw-13. Affected route: /v1/generate (model: rdx-large-v2-q4).

sre_jordan: seeing a bunch of the same stack on the warmup runs, nodes hitting GPU OOM during model initialization. Paging now.

oncall-alex: joining. thanks. any customer impact flagged yet?

prod_support_ted: two customer reports of higher error rates and 504s starting ~7:02 UTC. both on dedicated pools backed by cluster-rw-13. raising impact to degraded.

eng_runtime: adding logs — we saw deserialization fail a few times then OOM during allocator commit. possible new quantization path triggers larger peak memory at init. snippet:```
E 07:04:11 loader.cpp:223 load_model() failed: cudaMemcpyAsync failed: out of memory
E 07:04:11 kv_cache.cpp:88 init() failed: gpu alloc 0x7ff.. rejected
W 07:04:12 compile.cpp:412 Jit compile timed out after 12s (kernel: attention_dot)
```

ops_maria: nodes 13-16 show repeated container restarts (OOM killer) and one node (13) flagged as NotReady by k8s after kernel panic.

oncall-alex: immediate mitigation candidates: 1) failover traffic to us-east-2/dedicated fallback pools 2) pin to previous model variant (rdx-large-v2-fp16) 3) disable new quantized kernel via runtime flag. preferences?

eng_runtime: recommend disabling the new quant kernel globally for the cluster (fast rollback) and draining nodes 13-16 for manual inspection. we can also enable compiled-kernel fallback (slower) but that requires a config push.

sre_jordan: starting failover to fallback pools now. running gradual shift to avoid stampede. oncall-alex, can you confirm routing rule?

oncall-alex: routing change in progress: projecting 100% shift to us-east-2-fallback over ~2m with 10% steps. watch for client-side timeouts.

incident-bot: action logged — rerouteTrafficToFallback (initiated by oncall-alex) at 07:07:30 UTC.

prod_support_ted: alerted affected customers with preliminary note: "We’re investigating elevated errors for requests routed to us-east-1. We have initiated failover and will update in 15m."

eng_runtime: pushed runtime flag to disable quant-kernel on cluster-rw-13 (flag: runtime.disable_quant_kernel=true). waiting for warmup runs to confirm.

sre_jordan: nodes draining + restart loop stopped on 14-16 after flag. memory peaks reduced on warmup. but node 13 still NotReady — requires host-level investigation.

ops_maria: I’m hopping onto host 13 console (serial) — I see kernel logs indicating GPU driver panic and one bad ECC error. collecting /var/log/syslog and nvidia-smi log.

eng_runtime: compile timeout root cause theory: on these driver versions, certain PTX patterns in the new quant kernel trigger long JIT compile times that push the async GPU alloc window past our soft limit and then OOM. combination of larger working set during model init + compile pause = spike.

sre_jordan: mitigation status: traffic routed to fallback pools, runtime flag disabled, majority of warmups successful. residual impact: some in-flight requests in us-east-1 failed and retried by clients. incident severity remains SEV2 until node 13 returns.

pm_elena: customers affected: 2 enterprise customers on Dedicated inus-east-1 experiencing errors; churn/monetary impact low but SLA exposure possible. please keep support updated.

eng_runtime: paste of the model init trace for reference:```
[model-init] rdx-large-v2-q4: loading weights shard 3/8
allocating buffers: 13.7GB
compiling kernel: attention_dot (PTX size 118KB)
compile step 1/3... compile step 2/3... 
ERROR: JIT compile exceeded 12s, falling back to host emulation
cudaMalloc returned OutOfMemory while allocating 5.3GB
```

ops_maria: host 13: ECC error persisted during reboot, PCIe reset necessary. planning a hard power-cycle and driver reinstall. scheduling maintenance window 07:30 UTC to minimize further churn.

oncall-alex: action checklist: 1) keep traffic on fallback pools until all nodes healthy (oncall) 2) ops to recover node13 with hardware/assert driver (ops_maria) 3) eng_runtime to run regression against quant kernel on driver matrix (eng_runtime) 4) support to update customers (prod_support_ted).

prod_support_ted: prepping a follow-up message: "We’ve routed traffic away from the impacted cluster and are replacing affected hosts. No data exfiltration. We’ll confirm when all hosts are healthy."

sre_jordan: handoff to night oncall at 08:00 UTC. leaving runbook steps documented. current state: fallback routing active, 2 customers impacted earlier, node 13 under hardware recovery, cluster functional otherwise.

oncall-alex: passing to night-team. if node 13 recovers, revert routing after 3 consecutive warmup successes with flag disabled.

eng_runtime: follow-ups: repro harness to stress-init with quant-kernel compile delay; add a configurable compile-timeout threshold; add precompile step during CI for critical kernels on our supported driver matrix.

ops_maria: note for RCA: hardware/driver interplay + new quant kernel increased peak mem transiently. suspected triage: 60% software (kernel compile logic), 40% hardware frag on node13.

pm_elena: thanks all. tracking notes for postmortem — please append timestamps and owners to the runbook items. closing slack thread after handoff. :white_check_mark:
